business_problem: Bumpp needed a scalable database for AI-powered sales workflows, CRM detail updates, and signup spikes as the startup prepared for rapid growth.
solution_summary: Bumpp built its AI-powered networking assistant on MongoDB Atlas so sales teams could spend less time on admin work and more time on closing deals. Atlas stores contact, meeting, CRM, lead-status, and activity data for workflows that automate note taking, follow-up scheduling, team-performance tracking, and other sales-support tasks. The startup began on Atlas' free tier and then relied on elastic scaling to automate upgrades and absorb onboarding spikes, while keeping costs low and integrating cleanly with AWS. That foundation let Bumpp support more than 300 organizations across 14 countries, save users significant time, and keep expanding its AI feature set and language support.
